guides.wedding-countdown-widget.title: Wedding Countdown: Milestones Worth Tracking
guides.wedding-countdown-widget.desc: A wedding countdown is more useful when it tracks real deadlines rather than just days. Here are the milestones that actually gate bookings and RSVPs.
guides.wedding-countdown-widget.lead: The number of days until the wedding is motivating but not actionable. The useful countdown shows the next deadline and what it unlocks.
guides.wedding-countdown-widget.f1v: Venue, date, budget ceiling and officiant
guides.wedding-countdown-widget.f2v: Save-the-dates, travel blocks, attire and key vendors
guides.wedding-countdown-widget.f3v: Invitations out, RSVP deadline set, menu and music chosen
guides.wedding-countdown-widget.f4v: Final headcount, seating, timeline and final payments
guides.wedding-countdown-widget.s1: Tie each milestone to a dependency. Invitations cannot go out until the guest list and address list are final; the seating chart cannot start until RSVPs close; the caterer cannot price until the headcount is confirmed. A countdown that shows these as tasks rather than dates is a planning tool instead of a decoration.
guides.wedding-countdown-widget.s2: For a US wedding, save-the-dates commonly go out six to eight months ahead and invitations six to eight weeks ahead, earlier for destination weddings. UK timelines are often tighter, with formal invitations around six to eight weeks and less emphasis on save-the-dates. If guests need visas, a destination wedding needs a longer track — twelve months is not excessive.
guides.wedding-countdown-widget.s3: Do not set the RSVP deadline on the same day as the caterer's final count. Do not use a countdown that changes with your device's timezone, and check how it behaves across daylight saving changes. If you embed it on a wedding website, make sure it does not expose a private guest list or a venue address before the invitations go out.
guides.wedding-countdown-widget.a1: Six to eight months before the wedding, and up to twelve months for a destination wedding or a peak-season date requiring travel.
guides.wedding-countdown-widget.q2: How long before the wedding do invitations go out?
guides.wedding-countdown-widget.a2: Commonly six to eight weeks, with an RSVP deadline three to four weeks before the day so the final headcount has room to breathe.
guides.wedding-countdown-widget.q3: What belongs on a wedding website countdown?
guides.wedding-countdown-widget.a3: Public milestones and a clear RSVP deadline. Keep the venue address, guest list and any private schedule behind access controls.
